book.title: Mareko Iesu Keriso Hari Manoḡa Marekoꞌa Mirihiro

content: Nazareta Azaḡaniꞌa Iesu Hezahoharo
Iesuꞌa eꞌe habaꞌa modadu ane haba onamiro. Ane tahiꞌatahiꞌaꞌa zuni ḡatiniro.

Bana Madaḡa meirotene, ani nuꞌonuꞌo neḡano ihore ḡadahiro, ebu iniuꞌa eꞌe igiroteꞌe azaḡa ḡehaḡaniꞌa zaguzagaro. Ze ꞌahige ḡadimutitiro, “Vaze ꞌahiꞌe noumaonoꞌo ꞌahiguḡa niduꞌa meiro? Aniꞌa meiroteꞌe zamaroneḡa huhuzaḡaꞌe nagini? Ani haḡai gigiꞌa nougenouge haḡaeꞌohe?
Vaze ahiꞌe ne ogoruꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa zu Maria ubuga, oꞌehe? Ani negoḡa duḡuruꞌe Iakobo, Iosefa, Iuda ebu Simona. Ane ezeḡa niduꞌaꞌe ꞌahao emeḡe teite radiuꞌohe.” Ebu zeꞌa ani hezahoharo.
Ebu Iesuꞌa ziro, “Peroveta vazeḡaꞌe haba nunu zamaḡano vazeꞌa gubaneꞌohe, rehano ane haba azaḡa, ane nabuga ebu ane ne azaḡaniꞌa daꞌo mene gubaneꞌohe.”
Aniꞌa eꞌea haḡai gigiꞌa ꞌahoga zuni mene haḡairo, rehano ane ꞌevore ugi azaḡa nu rana teadu faiziro.
Ebu Iesuꞌe zeḡeꞌa ani mazao mene firoteꞌe uꞌano zaguzagaro. Iesuꞌa Ane Tahiꞌatahiꞌa Gaubanana Aheu Fare Tuḡuziro (Mataio 10:1, 5-15; Luka 9:1-6) Ebu Iesuꞌa neḡaneḡa ragaveꞌenaꞌa, ihoziro.
Aniꞌa ane tahiꞌa gaubanana aheu fare huze nuꞌoziro. Ebu ze aheuaheu tuḡuzadu vine sauꞌasauꞌa hegoze buziꞌeteꞌe gigiꞌaḡa ziniro.
Ebu aniꞌa ihoziro, “Zae ragavo zamaḡano ḡau ꞌahoga ago moꞌi, rehano tuḡuze daꞌo moꞌi. Ogomu ga fuse ago odohoꞌi, ebu niharazeo hadi zuni ago odohoꞌi.
Tamakaze haḡaoꞌi, rehano dabua ꞌahoga ago odohoꞌi.
Noꞌe neḡa diuḡoꞌidene eꞌea daꞌo radoꞌi, onamo ne eꞌe mode iḡunoꞌi.
Noꞌe habaꞌa azaḡaniꞌa zae mene mae zouzoꞌidene, ga ḡoereze mene egozenoꞌidene, odaze huꞌuruḡa zauhe mode manahadu eꞌe habaꞌa mode iḡunoꞌi. ꞌOuge haḡadu zeḡeꞌa zae mazao sauꞌa haḡairoteꞌe ihozoꞌi.”
Eꞌanoꞌo ze onamadu vazeꞌa ḡihuroga veize haramiro.
Zeꞌe vine sauꞌa ḡehaḡa hegoze buziro ebu ugi azaḡa ḡehaḡa mazao dehoro asozenadu faiziro.
Ioane Babatisoꞌa Rudaro

Iesu niꞌe haba niduꞌa zamaḡano bororanadu vaze niduꞌa ederiro ꞌahine, Galilea habaꞌa kiniḡa, Heroda zuni Iesu moneo igiro. Vaze nuꞌe ꞌahige rae reiro, “Ioane Babatisoꞌa rune azaḡa boꞌaḡano bare ḡabodiro. Eꞌanoꞌo aneꞌa haḡai gigiꞌa inaraḡa hina gaueꞌohe.”
Ebu vaze nuꞌe raenaꞌa, “Aniꞌe Elia,” ebu vaze nuꞌe raenaꞌa, “Aniꞌe amahi peroveta azaḡa boꞌaḡano vaze ꞌahoga.”
Rehano Herodaꞌa eꞌe igirotene, ꞌahige rae reiro, “Eḡeꞌa ꞌunuḡa variꞌe riꞌiroteꞌe vazeḡa, Ioaneꞌa runeonoꞌo ḡabodeha!”
Ibite Herodaꞌa negoḡa Filipi inuga Herodia meiro ꞌahine, Ioaneꞌa roniro. Eꞌanoꞌo Herodaꞌa uti azaḡa tuḡuzadu Ioane obone tiro ebu ḡuꞌa neḡano ohoniro.
Mazaḡa Ioaneꞌa Heroda mazao barebare niro, “Ḡaꞌa negoḡo inuga meirotaꞌaꞌe mene duduḡa.”
Eꞌanoꞌo Herodiaꞌa Ioane agirohanadu matihi reiro, rehano mene idararo.
Mazaḡa Ioaneꞌe duduḡa zu zaḡoḡa vazeḡa rae Herodaꞌa ederadu aniꞌe Ioane rihoniro ebu ani biriro. Ebu ani Ioane ḡoere igirotene, zamazeꞌa ufeta ꞌadaꞌadaziro, rehano Ioane ḡoere egoga uratiro.
Rehano mada manoḡa ꞌahoganiꞌa ariro. Herodaꞌa fureraroteꞌe madaḡa meirotene, aniꞌa vaze boroboro zu uti vazeḡa ḡihiꞌaḡaḡihiꞌaḡa ebu Galilea habaꞌa azaḡa boroboro huzadu mui boro haḡairo.
Ebu Heroda aboḡaniꞌa diuḡi aradu zavonirotene, aniꞌa Heroda ebu ane iꞌudo azaḡa matuꞌoziro. ꞌOugadu kini Herodaꞌa aboḡa niro, “Ḡa urani ꞌahoga umihoꞌi, ꞌougine eḡeꞌa ḡaniꞌuma.”
Ebu Herodaꞌa ani teite ḡoitoradu ane ḡoere rinede tiro, “Ḡa nagini umihine, ḡaniꞌuma. Ḡaeꞌa uratoꞌidene, eḡe haba niduꞌaonoꞌo ḡahaꞌa zuni ḡaniꞌuma.”
ꞌOugadu roḡae eꞌea bua onamadu viꞌa niro, “E nagini uminiꞌuma?” Viꞌaniꞌa naenaeniro, “Ioane Babatiso vadini uminoꞌi.”
Roḡae eꞌeꞌa zogone kini vaḡe bare onamadu uminiro, “Izidi ꞌada Ioane Babatiso vadini siuva rana teadu eḡe enoga urateꞌohe.”
Herodaꞌe zamaḡaniꞌa ufeta adudaro, rehano ani aneꞌa huziroteꞌe azaḡa zamao ane ḡoere rinede tiro ꞌahine, aboḡaniꞌa uminiroteꞌe ḡauḡa hezahohanoga mene uratiro.
Eꞌanoꞌo aniꞌa zogone ane uti vazeḡa ꞌahoga riḡa ḡorenadu Ioane vadini variꞌe riꞌioga veize tuḡuniro. Ebu uti vazeḡaniꞌa onamadu ḡuꞌa neḡano Ioane vadini variꞌe riꞌiro.
Ebu vadigaꞌe siuva rana teadu bare odohe ariro ebu roḡae tahiꞌaḡa hanadu aneꞌa viꞌa haro.
Ioane tahiꞌatahiꞌaꞌa ꞌahi igirotene, onamadu Ioane ahiri meiro ebu idu zamaḡano guriro.
Vaze Niduꞌa 5,000 Ḡubuziro
Apostolo azaḡaniꞌa Iesu varahe nuꞌoraro. Ebu zeḡeꞌa haḡairoteꞌe zu ihoziroteꞌe niduꞌa ani mazao meꞌodiro.
Eꞌea vaze ḡehaḡaniꞌa oname onainu ꞌahine, ze ogatiteꞌe madaḡani ꞌahoga oꞌoꞌa. ꞌOugadu Iesuꞌa ziro, “Vaze oꞌoꞌa habaꞌa ꞌahoga onamihi ebu ahirife tahiḡa ohonihi.”
Ebu ze zeḡe daꞌo ḡasi hina vaze oꞌoꞌa habaꞌa onamiro.
Rehano vaze ḡehaḡaniꞌa ze horozadu zeꞌa onameꞌetaꞌaꞌe ederiro. Ebu neḡaneḡa niduꞌaonoꞌo odao ze zamao dure ibitiro.
Iesuꞌa ḡasionoꞌo buanadu vaze ḡuḡuvaḡa horozirotene vetuḡaziro, mazaḡa zeꞌe vazeꞌa mene taufeꞌeteꞌe mamoeḡa teigiro. Eꞌanoꞌo ani ḡau ḡehaḡa moneo ze ḡadahe ihoziro.
Ḡoravararotene, Iesu tahiꞌatahiꞌaꞌa ani vaḡe aradu niro, “ꞌAhiꞌe haba bohaꞌa zu mada ꞌai zubureha.
Ogomuze hoite afine, vaze niduꞌa ne uhiḡauhiḡano tuḡuze vaḡizoꞌi.”
Rehano ani naenaeziro, “Zaeꞌa ogomu nu zenoꞌi.” Rehano zeḡeꞌa niro, “Zeḡe niduꞌa veize bato fuꞌo uḡidu fare gauḡa hadiḡa
meine, idaḡa! Emeꞌa eꞌe hadiḡa ufeta boro hina ꞌuvahu odoga hoitadu zeḡe ḡubuziꞌumahe?”
Iesuꞌa ḡadiziro, “Zae mazao ꞌuvahu odoga nugu eꞌe? Onamadu ḡianoꞌi.” Zeꞌa ḡianadu niro, “Emeḡe mazaoꞌe ꞌuvahu odoga fuꞌo zu ḡozone aheu.”
Ebu Iesuꞌa vaze niduꞌa ve ḡabodoraḡa rana rovonerovone ehorifine ane tahiꞌatahiꞌa ziro.
Ebu ze vaze 100 ga 50 rovonerovone ehoriro.

Ebu Iesuꞌa ꞌuvahu odoga fuꞌo zu ḡozone aheu madu adure ite ḡianeꞌenaꞌa, Badiꞌa mazao manoḡa tauḡi reiro. Ebu ꞌuvahu odoga vahege tahitahadu ane tahiꞌatahiꞌa ziniro, ebu ze vaze niduꞌa ḡahuge ziniro. Aniꞌa ḡozone aheu zuni zeḡe niduꞌa ḡahuge ziniro.
ꞌOugadu zeḡe niduꞌa au ubararo.
Ebu Iesu tahiꞌatahiꞌaꞌa ꞌuvahu odoga zu ḡozone ḡahaꞌaḡahaꞌa nuꞌonadu tunahu niduꞌa gaubanana aheu fare iriꞌavoniro.
Ogaroteꞌe azaḡa ohoze daꞌoꞌe niduꞌa 5,000.
Vu rana Onamiro
Iesuꞌa zogone ane tahiꞌatahiꞌa tuḡuzeꞌenaꞌa ziro, “Ḡasio tiradu eḡe vitihe duꞌura moneafa faradu Betesaida onamoꞌi.” U Iesuꞌe vaze ḡuḡuvaḡa tuḡuziro.
Aniꞌa ze muhiziroteꞌe enogano kuranoga radu maḡa komeꞌa itiro.
Ḡoravararotene, ḡasizeꞌe duꞌura nemao radiro ebu Iesuꞌe ane daꞌo gabao radiro.
Aniꞌe ane tahiꞌatahiꞌaꞌa ḡurizabuo reve inaroga horoziro, mazaḡa zavara boroꞌa zeḡe vaḡe gudau ariro. Iraranae reirotene, aniꞌa duꞌura rana edanadu zeḡe vaḡe onamiro. Ani zeḡe vitizihi reiro.
Rehano ze aniꞌa duꞌura rana ariroteꞌe horonirotene, aniꞌe vine rae zamariro. Ebu ze huau ḡaniḡanaro,
mazaḡa zeḡe niduꞌa ani horonadu rihau rudaro. Rehano Iesuꞌa zogone ziro, “Zamaze rinedoꞌi! ꞌAdiꞌe eḡe. Ago rihanoꞌi.”
Ebu ani zeḡe teite ḡasio tiriro ebu zavaraꞌa dauḡiro. ꞌOugadu zeꞌe zaguzagau rudaro,
mazaḡa ze Iesuꞌa ꞌuvahu odoga hina vaze ḡehaḡa ḡubuziroteꞌe moneo huga mene ederiro zu zamazeꞌe turaro.
Ugi Azaḡa Faiziro
Ze duꞌura faradu Genesareta neḡano hebetiro ebu ḡasi eꞌea ute tiro.
Ze ḡasionoꞌo buarotene, haba eꞌe azaḡaniꞌa Iesuꞌa arirotaꞌaꞌe ederiro.
Ze eꞌe habaꞌa neḡaneḡa niduꞌa dure ragaviro ebu Iesuꞌa noꞌe habaꞌano radiuꞌeteꞌe igirotene, ugi azaḡa farata rana heratadu Iesu vaḡe tutuze onamiro.

Ebu ani noꞌe neḡa zamaḡa, ne boro ga ne komeꞌa onamirotene, ze ugi azaḡa maketi habaꞌano bazune tiro. Ebu ugi azaḡaniꞌa ani dabua ꞌariḡa tahiḡa daꞌo obonoga veize uminiro. ꞌOugadu oboniroteꞌe azaḡa niduꞌaꞌe ugizeꞌa manoriro.
